metadata.scope: Base game plus released gameplay DLC through 2026-10-04

confidence_legend.confirmed: directly supported by a source with matching scope/version or independent corroboration sufficient for the specific field
confidence_legend.candidate: public evidence exists but source version or identity/role is not fully reconciled
confidence_legend.unknown: no reliable evidence for the field; null must not be inferred

metadata.coverage_status: partial_public_source_census; not a complete verified 1.11.2 roster
notes: Fextralife snapshot predates update 1.11. Official 1.11/1.11.2 notes were reviewed; Board Game Piece is the only named new object and is a home cosmetic.

The 308 Fextralife rows are public visible index entries, not an official exact-version export. The independent database and 1.9.3 mirror add or disambiguate candidates, not complete current-version coverage.
is_building means a settlement-placeable object according to the source index; it does not imply inclusion in the campaign runtime catalog. Event objects are not settlement buildings.
